title: Clarity Arc
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small single-pass 180-second stereo master; a continuous 128-second excerpt from 32s forms the station mix and its first 64 seconds form the game mix; -9 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Create an original 180-second stereo melodic trance instrumental at steady 144 BPM in 4/4 for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game. By 24 seconds a full uplifting groove plays: solid four-on-the-floor kick every quarter beat, clean clap on two and four, shimmering eighth hats, rolling bass, warm suspended chords and a distinct short plucked arpeggio attack on every quarter beat. Signature hook: seven short climbing notes arc back into a two-note low resolution; after 96 seconds change chord roots and invert the resolution while preserving full rhythmic energy. Keep 32-to-160 seconds continuously melodic and near-uniform in loudness, not an exact repeated half. Luminous and clear, with no vocals, speech, samples, copied melody, tempo drift, quiet bridge, breakdown, fade or silence in the selected passage.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Original high-contrast comic-print cover: a single open cyan frequency arc crosses two thin ivory guide lines and resolves into a coral square, no planet, ring, star, landscape, character or text.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Wide duohertz card with open frequency arc on right and Clarity Arc title on left.
art_provenance.render_method: local macOS sips SVG-to-PNG; source raster equality checked before staging
art_provenance.cover_svg: Local SVG title overlay around the authored cover-art.png
